note: Pattern lines of the TWENTY ONE TV reactions to the stream chat and to zaps (App\Support\Caster\ReactionLines): spoken German, one sentence per line, at most 16 words and two commas, no hashtags, no fees, no Lightning address, no 'Gesicht'. Placeholders: {wer} (a trusted zapper's name or 'Jemand im Chat'/'Ein Zuschauer', always opens the sentence), {sats} (the amount spelled out with 'Sats'), {anzahl} (the number of zaps, spelled out), {name} (a trusted chatter's name). reply_* pools answer a trusted chatter's message by its intent (ReactionLines::intent()): {name} opens the line ('{name}, …'), follows a greeting word ('Servus {name}, …') or closes it (', {name}.'), so it can be taken out when there is no speakable name; at most one marker. Nothing a chatter wrote is ever read out.
